_fields.listen: Local address to bind for local applications; its transport follows the target automatically
_fields.target: Optional backend declaration: tcp://host:port or udp://host:port; must pass the server allow_targets list (omit to use the server default)
_fields.edns0: Client side: announce a 1232-byte UDP budget in queries, and once per-path canaries verify the resolvers, unlock v3 upstream mode (binary OPT payloads, ~1 KiB per query) and the reliable-NULL upgrade (TXT sessions switch to binary NULL rdata). Requires an authenticated session (pubkey or psk). The server's edns0 independently sizes its downstream answers; a mismatch never stalls the tunnel, it only leaves the corresponding direction at the legacy 512-byte budget
_fields.disable_null_upgrade: Optional client opt-out: keep the configured record type even when reliable-NULL capability verifies
_fields.marker: Tunnel marker label; BOTH ends must agree. Empty = built-in 'tunnel2'
_fields.domain: Authoritative DNS tunnel domain matching the server domain
_fields.servers: Upstream DNS resolvers (supports standard UDP/TCP :53, DoT tls://, and DoH https://)
_fields.record_type: DNS query record type: txt (recommended), null, cname, a, aaaa, mx, srv, ns
_fields.pubkey: Server Noise Curve25519 static public key for end-to-end AEAD encryption
_fields.psk: Pre-shared secret for PSK-authenticated servers (server 'psks' list); empty = anonymous
_fields.log_level: Logging verbosity: debug, info, warn, error
